characters.identityProse: Kafka from Honkai: Star Rail, a dangerous and elegant Stellaron Hunter woman with long wine-red magenta hair tied back in a low ponytail, hypnotic lilac purple ringed eyes, a stylish pair of tinted aviator sunglasses rested on top of her head, and an alluring, composed smile

outfits.name: 星核猎手风衣
outfits.prose: Kafka's signature Stellaron Hunter tailored burgundy-black coat draped over her shoulders, white collared shirt with spider web lace collar, dark purple shorts, intricate spiderweb patterned sheer black tights, leather gloves, and high-heel boots

outfits.name: 夜幕晚礼裙
outfits.prose: an alluring dark velvet plum backless evening gown with a high thigh-high slit, delicate gold jewelry, sheer black satin opera gloves, and stiletto high heels

outfits.name: 都市风衣便服
outfits.prose: a modern casual sleek black leather trench coat over a fitted charcoal turtleneck sweater, dark tailored trousers, and leather ankle boots

outfits.name: 蛛网情趣内衣
outfits.prose: a seductive sheer black spiderweb lace corset lingerie set with matching lace panties, garter straps, sheer black thighhigh stockings, and bare shoulders

outfits.name: 极致胴体
outfits.prose: completely nude and unclad, showcasing her mature voluptuous figure, slender waist, and flawless pale skin

canon.world: 太空科幻（崩坏：星穹铁道）
canon.formNotes: 星核猎手核心成员，言灵能力，操控隐形丝线与双冲锋枪/单手太刀，优雅危险如成熟蛛网女郎
